💼 Hiring: Freelance Machine Learning Engineer - Pakistan

I’m looking for a reliable Machine Learning Engineer to work on a specialized AI/ML project on a contract basis.

Requirements:
- Strong Python and practical machine learning experience
- Experience with NLP, RAG, recommendation systems, object detection, sequence-to-sequence models, or LLM evaluation
- Ability to design datasets, evaluation methods, grading logic, and reproducible ML pipelines
- Strong understanding of data leakage, train/test splitting, model evaluation, and CPU optimization
- Comfortable working with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or similar tools
- Ability to write clear technical documentation
- Strong GitHub, Kaggle, research, or project portfolio
- Good communication and ability to meet deadlines

Important:
This is not a basic model-training or beginner-level task
- A short paid technical assessment will be required
- All work must be original and properly documented
- NDA and intellectual-property agreement will be required
- Preference will be given to candidates based in Pakistan
- The main task details will be shared after hiring.

Please send me:
Your GitHub, Kaggle, or portfolio links (No CV)
Relevant project examples
Your availability and expected rate
Send your application through LinkedIn DM or comment your links.
